"""The ``stripe`` webhook route: its parser and its secret."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import replace

from xtr_dependency_injection import configure, env
from xtr_webhook.bundle import RouteConfig, WebhookConfig

from app.webhook.stripe_request_parser import StripeRequestParser

__all__ = ["webhook_stripe"]


@configure
def webhook_stripe(config: WebhookConfig) -> WebhookConfig:
    """Add the route to whatever routing is configured, in every environment.

    The secret is a placeholder, read when the endpoint is built: set
    ``STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`` in ``.env.local``, never here.
    """
    route = RouteConfig(
        parser=StripeRequestParser,
        secret=env("STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET"),
    )
    routing = {**config.routing, "stripe": route}
    return replace(config, routing=routing)
